name: placecell
description: PlaceCell — campus placement portal for students, recruiters, and placement cells

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gw,id,cat,app,match,iv,nt,an,worker,web -c blue,cyan,green,magenta,yellow,red,white,gray,blueBright,greenBright "npm run start:gw --prefix server" "npm run start:identity --prefix server" "npm run start:catalog --prefix server" "npm run start:applications --prefix server" "npm run start:matching --prefix server" "npm run start:interviews --prefix server" "npm run start:notifications --prefix server" "npm run start:analytics --prefix server" "npm run start:worker --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:mono: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.docker:infra: docker compose up -d mongo redis minio
